backup.title: Backup & Recovery
backup.subtitle: Protect, verify and recover your financial records
backup.noBackupYet: No verified external backup yet. Export and verify to confirm recovery.
backup.step1: 1. Regularly create and save your encrypted .fmz backup file to a safe cloud storage or second device.
backup.step2: 2. Memorise or safely write down your secret passphrase (it cannot be reset).
backup.step3: 3. In case of lost phone, install Barakah on a new device and choose 'Restore from Backup'.
backup.step4: 4. Provide your .fmz file and passphrase to instantly recover all accounts and ledgers.
backup.honestNoticeBody: Barakah stores your live database strictly on this device without encryption. Exported .fmz files are strongly encrypted with your passphrase. Barakah cannot recover forgotten passphrases.
backup.createSubtitle: Export an encrypted .fmz file containing all accounts, transactions, debts, and categories
backup.ackNotice: I understand that Barakah cannot recover or reset my passphrase if I forget it.
backup.exportSuccessBody: Your encrypted backup file has been generated.
backup.verifySubtitle: Verify file integrity, encryption tag, and table checksums without modifying your device data
backup.verifySuccessBody: The backup file is valid, intact, and matches all financial data integrity rules.
backup.webUnsupported: Encrypted backup and restore operations are not supported in web browser runtimes due to browser storage limitations. Please use the mobile application on Android or iOS.

restore.title: Restore Data
restore.subtitle: Restore your financial history from an encrypted .fmz backup file
restore.previewSubtitle: Review the backup contents before replacing data on this device
restore.warningBody: Restoring will completely replace your current device data with the backup contents. This operation cannot be merged or undone. A pre-restore safety snapshot will be created automatically.
restore.webUnsupported: Restore operations are not supported in web browser runtimes. Please use the mobile application on Android or iOS.
restore.confirmCheckbox: I confirm that I want to replace all current device data with this backup.
restore.restoreSuccessBody: All accounts, transactions, debts, and counterparties have been restored to your device.
